button.$comment: The height comes from the token shared with the field ({pct.control.height}), not from vertical padding — otherwise a button and a field row of the same size cannot be lined up (req-api-size). The `-sm` / `-lg` variants swap the base tokens; size `md` keeps to the base tokens themselves.

fg.$description: Label and spinner colour on the solid face.

border.$description: Edge of the solid and outline faces.

bg-disabled.$description: Background of any face while disabled.

fg-disabled.$description: Label colour while disabled — measured on purpose, though SC 1.4.3 exempts it.

height.$description: Height at size md — the control axis every field shares, so rows line up.

button.$comment-icon-size: The glyph on the icon-only face (0085): the icon's own three steps, one per size, so the glyph takes the same share of the square at every size — 16 / 20 / 24 inside 28 / 36 / 44. Literals and not references, because the steps are the icon's tokens and a component token pointing at another component's is the sideways reference req-token-override forbids: overriding `--pct-icon-size` must not resize a button.

icon-size.$description: Glyph size on the icon-only face at size md.

icon-size-sm.$description: Glyph size on the icon-only face at size sm.

icon-size-lg.$description: Glyph size on the icon-only face at size lg.

button.$comment-target-min: The floor under both axes of the icon-only face (req-a11y-touch). A labelled button is as wide as its words; a square is as wide as its height, and a skin that shrinks the height would shrink the target with it. The heights clear it at every size and density today — this is what a theme that goes further runs into.

target-min.$description: Smallest box the icon-only face draws, on both axes.
